Additionally, the model should include an opt-out mechanism for sensitive behavioral data and ensure that 'equal recall' does not come at the cost of alienating students through impersonal outreach.

Therefore, implementation should include an opt-in tier or human-mediated exception process to allow this data when explicitly justified by specific support needs.
